description: This file contains Pydantic models for a notes API, including request, response, and validation models related to notes management (create, update, list, search, delete).

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Base model for note data, containing title and content fields.

classes.name: NoteCreateRequest
classes.description: Model for incoming request to create a new note, inherits from NoteBase.

classes.name: NoteUpdateRequest
classes.description: Model for updating a note; fields are optional for partial updates.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: Model for representing a note in responses, includes ID and timestamps.

classes.name: NotesListResponse
classes.description: Model for listing multiple notes, includes items, limit, and offset.

classes.name: NotesSearchResponse
classes.description: Extends list response to include the search query string.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Standard error response payload with descriptive message.

classes.name: DeleteResponse
classes.description: Response indicating whether a delete operation was successful.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: Validated query parameters for search operations, includes q, limit, and offset.

classes.name: ListQuery
classes.description: Validated query parameters for listing notes, includes limit and offset.

methods.name: str strip_and_validate_q(cls, v: str)
methods.description: Validator that strips whitespace from search query q and ensures it is not empty.

ctags.pattern: /^class DeleteResponse(BaseModel):$/

ctags.pattern: /^class ErrorResponse(BaseModel):$/
